messages:
maria: quick sync — we need a design review for the Fastpass auth flow (API + SDK + Console UX). aiming for a 45min session to walk wireframes, api shape, and rollout plan. proposed slots: Tue 10-11, Wed 3-4, Thu 11-12. which works? also please complete the pre-read checklist below before the meeting. link: https://redwood.internal/docs/fastpass

alex: Thu 11-12 works for me. 45min is fine. do we need infra/canary time?

lina: i can do Tue 10 but prefer Thu 11. will finish wireframe comments by EOD Mon.

sachin: thumbs up for Thu. i need to validate canary capacity. if we're discussing rollout, add 10-15m for deployment strategy.

jordan: out Tue afternoon. Thu 11 is best for me; can join the first 30m.

maria: thanks — sounds like Thu 11-12 is the best overlap. i'll tentatively book Thu 11. lina, can you move your slot? @lina

lina: i can move. moving now. i'll flag any UX open questions inline.

maria: pre-read checklist (quick):
```
Pre-read checklist:
- [ ] PR open (#456) with API shape and example requests
- [ ] Wireframes uploaded to /design/fastpass-v2 and annotated
- [ ] SDK proposal (types, surface, error model) draft in docs
- [ ] E2E test plan + canary steps (responsible: sachin)
- [ ] Rollback criteria & metrics to watch
- [ ] Security notes (auth flow, token lifetime)
```
please mark items when done and paste any blockers here.

alex: quick note: PR is draft `#456`, i'll push updates tonight. also +1 on adding 15m for canary.

sachin: i'll own the E2E/canary bullets. will post capacity notes by Mon noon.

jordan: small ask — can we add a short "expected failure modes" slide? helps on rollback criteria.

maria: good call. adding a 5-min slot for failure modes at the end of the review.

deploy-bot: Reminder: create calendar event with meeting link and attach pre-read doc. (automated)

maria: done — invite sent for Thu 11-12, included agenda and checklist. please use the RSVP and mark checklist items in the event doc.

alex: ✅ pushed updated API examples. left a todo about error codes.

lina: ✅ wireframes annotated. left 2 comments about edge flows.

sachin: posted canary capacity notes, added infra rollback steps.

jordan: will join Thu first 30. leaving a note on the calendar.

maria: awesome — looks like we're set. if any blockers pop up please ping me or drop here. i'll record the session for folks who can't make it. :thumbsup:
